Container.Name: ForgejoRunner
Container.Overview:
Forgejo Runner executes Forgejo Actions (CI/CD) workflows for a Forgejo instance. It uses the official Forgejo runner image.
SETUP ORDER: 1. Forgejo must be running and you must have an admin account. 2. Generate a registration token: docker exec -u git Forgejo forgejo forgejo-cli actions generate-runner-token 3. Register this runner (one-time, as root so it can write .runner): docker run --rm --user 0:0 -v /mnt/cache_virtual_ssd/appdata/forgejo-runner/data:/data -w /data data.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:12 forgejo-runner register --no-interactive --instance http://10.47.40.45:3100 --token YOUR_TOKEN --name tower05-runner --labels "ubuntu-latest:docker://ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest,docker:docker://ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest" 4. chown -R 99:100 the data dir, then start this container. It will appear online in Forgejo's Runners list.
NOTE: Runs as root (--user 0:0) so the daemon can access the host Docker socket to spin up job containers. The container command is 'forgejo-runner daemon'. Acceptable for a private single-user instance.

Config.Name: Config/Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the runner's registration file (.runner) and config.yml.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Allows the runner to create job containers on the host Docker daemon. Required for docker:// workflow labels.

Config.Name: Timezone (host)
Config.Description: Mounts the host timezone file so container timestamps match the Unraid timezone.
